messages.subject: [R-sig-ins] mbbefd distribution in R
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I have written an R package to handle MBBEFD distributions and underlying
exposure curves in R.

 

The package is mbbefd, of course.

 

Any comments welcome.

 

Giorgio
